acceptedAnswer.text: It is a solid managed cloud host. HostingAdvice scored its WordPress cloud plan an A on GTmetrix. Renewal prices rise sharply, and it has limited AI features.
HostingAdvice tested a cloud WordPress plan and reported an A on GTmetrix with a largest contentful paint of 983 ms.
Shared plans start at $2.95 a month on a 1-year term, according to TechRadar. Entry Cloud is $11.21 a month on a 1-year term during the Black Friday offer, against a $39.95 standard price.

mainEntity.name: Does ScalaHosting have a Black Friday deal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, on cloud plans only, from 19 October to 1 December 2026. There is no shared hosting deal this year.
SPanel is ScalaHosting's own control panel for managing sites, email and backups.
It lists SShield, which it describes as AI-powered security. We did not find an AI builder or assistant on the pages we read.
